```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(reticulate)
reticulate::use_condaenv("mofa2_env", required = TRUE)
reticulate::py_config()
reticulate::py_module_available("mofapy2")
reticulate::py_module_available("sklearn")

library(svdxBenchmark)
library(svdx)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```


# Check
```{r}
SEEDS <- 1:3
NG_GRID <- c(10, 20, 40)
CONFOUNDING_GRID <-c(0.0, .5) #c(0.0, 0.25, .5)
BATCH_TO_BIOLOGY_GRID <- 1

# Gaussian feature-wise residual variance:
# sigma_j^2 = sigma^2 * Gamma(shape = a, rate = a)
# Larger a => more similar variances across features.
FEATURE_NOISE_SHAPE_GRID <- c(1) 
BATCH_BIOLOGY_OVERLAP_GRID <- c(0, .5) 
BATCH_FEATURE_FRACTION <- .4
TIME_IMBALANCE_GRID <- c(.5) 

P <- 5000
G <- 5
B <- 5
K <- 15
N_MODULES <- 4
pi_signal <- (.1/N_MODULES) 

ALL_FACTORIZATION_METHODS <- c(
  "svdx",
  "pca",
  "mefisto_duplicate_view",
  "nmf",
  "mixomics_pls",
  "spca",
  "sparse_nmf" #see below
  )
INFERENCE_METHODS <- c("svdx")
SPCA_KEEPX_GRID <- round(c(0.01, 0.25, 0.5) * P)
SPARSE_NMF_LAMBDA_GRID <- 10^c(-3, -2, -1) 

cbio_cbatch = cbind( c(2,2) )

runFn <- function(cbio, cbatch, fname){
  
  single_grid <- run_single_benchmark_grid(
  
  seeds = 1:3,
  family_grid = "gaussian",
  fit_family = NULL,
  inference_family = "gaussian",

  ng_grid = NG_GRID,
  confounding_grid = CONFOUNDING_GRID,
  batch_to_biology_ratio_grid = BATCH_TO_BIOLOGY_GRID,
  feature_noise_shape_grid = FEATURE_NOISE_SHAPE_GRID,
  batch_biology_overlap_fraction_grid = BATCH_BIOLOGY_OVERLAP_GRID,
  time_imbalance_grid = TIME_IMBALANCE_GRID,

  p = P,
  G = G,
  B = B,
  K = K,
  n_modules = N_MODULES,

  simulator_args = list(
    pi_signal = pi_signal,
    batch_feature_fraction = BATCH_FEATURE_FRACTION, 
    severity_group_shift = 0 ,# this prevents severity from acting as a proxy for group
    c_bio=cbio,
    c_batch=cbatch
  ),

  run_factorization = TRUE,
  run_inference = TRUE,

  factorization_methods = ALL_FACTORIZATION_METHODS,
  inference_methods = INFERENCE_METHODS,

  spca_keepX_grid = SPCA_KEEPX_GRID,
  sparse_nmf_lambda_grid = SPARSE_NMF_LAMBDA_GRID,

  loading_top_n = 100,

  keep_runs = FALSE, 
  
  ## For svdx 
  numThreads = 3, 
  svdx_args = list( fitter_maxIter= 1000, fitter_eps = 1e-3, ftol_abs=1e-5 )
  )
  
  saveRDS( single_grid, file=fname  )
  
  single_grid
  
}

cbio <- 2
cbatch <- 2
fn <- paste0("./simulation_cbio_", cbio, "_cbatch_", cbatch, ".RDS")
runFn( cbio, cbatch, fn )


```


#Plots
```{r}

# Reconstruction error: all features, fitted K
bench <- readRDS( file=paste0("./simulation_cbio_", 2, "_cbatch_", 2, ".RDS") )

# Signal features only
signal <- plot_single_reconstruction_error(
  bench,
  feature_set = "signalFeatures",
  k_scope = c("svdxK")
)
#non signal features : both batch and null
nulls <- plot_single_reconstruction_error(
  bench,
  feature_set = "nonSignalFeatures",
  k_scope = c("svdxK")
)
#Inference
infSignal <- plot_single_inference_metrics(
  bench,
  metrics = c(
  "inference_auc_signal_vs_null",
  "power",
  "type1_error",
  "empirical_fdr"
), average_over = "seed" )


library(patchwork)
panel_tag_theme <- theme(
  plot.tag = element_text(
    size = 28,
    face = "bold",
    family = "Helvetica"
  ),
  plot.tag.position = c(0.1, 2)
)

#reconstruction at 0 batch/bio feature overlap, in signal and non-signal/nulls
a0_signalRec <- signal$signalFeatures__svdxK__all__0 + labs(title=NULL) + ylab( "Avg. reconstruction error: Signal" ) 
a0_signalRecZoomed <-a0_signalRec + ylim(c(0.25,1))
a0_nullRec <- nulls$nonSignalFeatures__svdxK__all__0 + labs(title=NULL) + ylab( "Avg. reconstruction error: Nulls" ); 
a0_power <- infSignal$power__0 + labs(title=NULL) + ylab("Power") + ylim(c(0,1))
a0_type1err <- infSignal$type1_error__0 + labs(title=NULL) + ylab("Type 1 error rate") + ylim(c(0, 1)) + geom_hline(yintercept = .05,linetype = 2)
a0_fdr <- infSignal$empirical_fdr__0 + labs(title=NULL) + ylab("FDR") + geom_hline(yintercept=.1,linetype = 2) + ylim(0,1)

#reconstruction at 50% batch/bio feature overlap, in signal and non-signal/nulls
a0p5_signalRec <- signal$signalFeatures__svdxK__all__0_5 + labs(title=NULL) + ylab( "Avg. reconstruction error: Signal" ); 
a0p5_signalRecZoomed <- a0p5_signalRec + ylim(c(0.25,.75))
a0p5_nullRec <- nulls$nonSignalFeatures__svdxK__all__0_5 + labs(title=NULL) + ylab( "Avg. reconstruction error: Nulls" );
a0p5_power <- infSignal$power__0_5 + labs(title=NULL) + ylab("Power") + ylim(c(0,1))
a0p5_type1err <- infSignal$type1_error__0_5 + labs(title=NULL) + ylab("Type 1 error rate") + ylim(c(0,1))+ geom_hline(yintercept = .05, linetype = 2)
a0p5_fdr <- infSignal$empirical_fdr__0_5 + labs(title=NULL) + ylab("FDR") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=.1, linetype = 2) + ylim(c(0,1))

#AUC
signalAuc <- plot_single_all_signal_pooled_auc(
  bench,
  k_scope = c("svdxK")
)
sfac <- plot_single_factorization_metrics(single_grid, average_over = c("seed"),
                                          facet_var = "confounding", 
  metrics = c(
    "loading_feature_auc_signal_vs_non_signal_at_svdxK",
    "loading_feature_auc_signal_vs_non_signal_at_allK",
    "loading_feature_auc_batch_vs_non_batch_at_svdxK",
    "loading_feature_auc_batch_vs_non_batch_at_allK",
    "loading_feature_auc_signal_vs_batch_only_at_svdxK"
  )
)
signalAuc_0 <- signalAuc$svdxK__0 + ylab( "Signal AUC" ) + labs(title=NULL)
batchAuc_0 <- sfac$loading_feature_auc_batch_vs_non_batch_at_svdxK__0 + ylab("Batch AUC") + labs(title=NULL)

signalAuc_0p5 <- signalAuc$svdxK__0_5 + ylab( "Signal AUC" ) + labs(title=NULL)
batchAuc_0p5 <- sfac$loading_feature_auc_batch_vs_non_batch_at_svdxK__0_5 + ylab("Batch AUC") + labs(title=NULL)


drop_adjusted <- function(p) {
  p$data <- p$data |>
    dplyr::filter(method != "svdx_adjusted")
  p
}  
b <- ggplot_build(a0_signalRec); #get colors
method_names <- b$plot$scales$get_scales("colour")$get_limits()

plot0 <- wrap_plots(
  drop_adjusted(a0_signalRec) + labs(tag = "A"),
  drop_adjusted(a0_signalRecZoomed),
  drop_adjusted(a0_nullRec),

  drop_adjusted(a0_power) + labs(tag = "B") + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  drop_adjusted(a0_type1err)               + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  drop_adjusted(a0_fdr)                    + theme(legend.position = "none"),

  drop_adjusted(signalAuc_0) + labs(tag = "C") + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  drop_adjusted(batchAuc_0)                       + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  guide_area(),

  ncol = 3,
  nrow = 3,
  guides = "collect"
) &
  scale_color_discrete(limits = method_names[method_names!="svdx_adjusted"]) &
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(ncol = 2)
  ) &
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1, 
        plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20), 
        text = element_text(size = 15),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 15),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
        )


plot0p5 <- wrap_plots(
  drop_adjusted(a0p5_signalRec) + labs(tag = "A"),
  drop_adjusted(a0p5_signalRecZoomed),
  drop_adjusted(a0p5_nullRec),

  drop_adjusted(a0p5_power) + labs(tag = "B") + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  drop_adjusted(a0p5_type1err)               + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  drop_adjusted(a0p5_fdr)                    + theme(legend.position = "none"),

  drop_adjusted(signalAuc_0p5) + labs(tag = "C") + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  drop_adjusted(batchAuc_0p5)                       + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  guide_area(),

  ncol = 3,
  nrow = 3,
  guides = "collect"
) &
  scale_color_discrete(limits = method_names[method_names!="svdx_adjusted"]) &
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(ncol = 2)
  ) &
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1, 
        plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20), 
        text = element_text(size = 15),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 15),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
        )



ggsave(
  filename = "./batch_overlap_fraction0_svdxK.pdf",
  plot = plot0 ,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  width = 15,
  height = 10,
  units = "in"
)
ggsave(
  filename = "./batch_overlap_fraction0p5_svdxK.pdf",
  plot = plot0p5 ,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  width = 15,
  height = 10,
  units = "in"
)
```
